Shitet, Apartament 1+1, Don Bosko, 115,000 Euro
Karakteristikat e prones:
– Apartament 1+1
– Don Bosko
– Pallati i ri ne ashensor
– Kati 7
– Siperfaqja bruto 54m²
– Siperfaqja neto 49m²
– Cmimi 115,000 Euro
Shitet apartament 1+1 me siperfaqe 54 m², i cili ndodhet ne katin e 7 te nje pallati te ri,ne Don Bsoko. Apartamenti eshte totalisht i invstuar edhe i shtruar me parket. Hyrja organizohet ne sallon ndenje, ambient gatimi, 1 dhomë gjumi, ballkoni dhe tualeti. Gjithashtu orientimi i tij jug-lindje – perendim ben qe apartamenti te ket gjate gjthe dites drite natyrale.
Ndodhet ne nje zonë të qetë e cila i ofron te gjitha facilitetet e nevojshme.
Apartamenti disponon dokumentacion të rregullt hipotekor.
Per me shume informacione ose per nje vizite ne prone kontaktoni ne numrin e agjencise imobiliare.

description_en: For sale, Apartment 1+1, Don Bosko, 115,000 Euro Property features: – Apartment 1+1 – Don Bosko – New building with elevator – Floor 7 – Gross area 54m² – Net area 49m² – Price 115,000 Euro 1+1 apartment for sale with an area of 54 m², which is located on the 7th floor of a building ri, in Don Bsoko. The apartment is completely invested and laid with parquet. The entrance is arranged in the living room, kitchen, 1 bedroom, balcony and toilet. Also, its south-east - west orientation means that the apartment has natural light all day long. It is located in a quiet area that offers all the necessary facilities. The apartment has regular mortgage documentation. For more information or for a visit to the property, contact the number of the real estate agency.
